scan.recordsPerPageMeaning: Proposed generic ceiling; each domain adapter's current limit may be lower.
scan.effectivePageSizeRule: min(proposed generic page size, current source adapter limit)

optionalExecutionEvaluation.missingLimitBehavior: Block optional-backend dispatch; do not invent defaults or run untrusted work inside trusted application.

admissionPolicy.modelSelection: Least expensive evaluated model accepted for this registered capability; no provider/model selected by untrusted input.
requiredBeforeCall: Versioned current rate card and bounded token/tool/deadline estimate
Atomic reservation of worst-case incremental cost before dispatch
admissionPolicy.reservationIdentity: Tenant + specialist invocation + call attempt; retry/replay cannot reserve or charge twice.
admissionPolicy.costRepresentation: Currency-qualified decimal strings with Decimal-compatible arithmetic; no binary floating-point money.
admissionPolicy.availableAllowance: Ceiling minus actual settled charge exposure and outstanding reservations within the rolling window, with unresolved liabilities retained until reconciled.
admissionPolicy.raceRule: One atomic admission checks both tenant and global limits. Concurrent workers cannot both consume the same remaining allowance.
admissionPolicy.repairAndEscalation: The single optional second model call is shared by repair or evaluated escalation, never one of each in addition to two calls. Reserve enough cost before each call; total invocation deadline/read-tool caps remain shared.
admissionPolicy.settle: Record actual provider usage and immutable model/rate-card versions; settle once and release only demonstrably unused reservation.
admissionPolicy.unknownUsage: Mark usage/cost reconciliation pending and retain conservative reserved exposure; missing usage never becomes free or a fabricated zero.
admissionPolicy.cancellation: Stop new calls and preserve in-flight usage/liability reconciliation. Human/event/timer waits consume no model calls.
admissionPolicy.prohibitedCostMixing: Track model, advertising/media/provider and optional infrastructure cost categories and allowances separately in accepted usage/audit storage; do not create new ledgers or hide transfers from the model allowance.

fallbackPolicy.budgetExhausted: Stop new model-dependent work. Use only an existing preapproved deterministic template where its independent eligibility/authority checks pass, otherwise show human review or needs_input.
fallbackPolicy.timeoutOrInvalidOutput: Return explicit fallback/handoff; do not silently accept partial or malformed output, loop, exceed the same deadline or invent missing source facts.
routineWorkContinues: Deterministic source updates and allowed scans

cachePolicy.cacheHitBehavior: Reuse only still-valid evidence-linked draft within matching versions/freshness; action authority and mutable facts are rechecked independently.
cachePolicy.publicAggregateReuse: Only permitted genuinely public/aggregate source summaries with their own provenance/allowed use; no tenant-private campaign/customer data.

evaluationPolicy.requireAllFourCapabilityGroupsMeaning: Preparation evaluation-packet coverage/full agreed release scope only. Runtime admission is per selected registered capability and accepted method graph; an unrelated unavailable group does not block a complete selected route.
evaluationPolicy.gate: Structured schema, allowed-read boundary, correct tenant, evidence support, uncertainty handling, authority separation, valid cost/usage recording and bounded repair must all pass accepted offline/adversarial evaluation before runtime enablement.
evaluationPolicy.numericalConfidence: Do not accept LLM self-rating as calibrated confidence; any numeric estimator needs evaluated version/evidence.
evaluationPolicy.promotion: Offline evaluation then shadow/recommendation comparison then separately authorized limited rollout; policy promotion never expands owner/customer authority.
